categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Silver Age Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in high-performance polymer new materials, including modified plastics, smart lighting, 3D printing materials, and fine chemicals. The company focuses on R&D, production, and sales of these materials, serving industries such as automotive, home appliances, electronics, new energy, aerospace, and communications. It also has a strategic presence in smart lighting products like intelligent light strips and lamps.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced polymer modification technologies including physical and chemical modification methods such as filling, blending, copolymerization, and crosslinking. Key production processes include precise formulation, mixing, extrusion, cooling, pelletizing, and packaging. It also develops proprietary flame retardant additives and environmentally friendly materials, with patented smart lighting technologies integrating IoT and AI for intelligent control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Silver Age serves major customers in automotive, home appliances, electrical cables, smart lighting, electronics, medical devices, new energy, aerospace, and robotics sectors. Its products are used by leading manufacturers requiring high-performance, environmentally friendly polymer materials and smart lighting solutions. The company maintains long-term cooperative relationships with core downstream enterprises and actively expands overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production and R&D bases across multiple locations in China including Dongguan, Zhuhai, Suzhou, Anhui, Zhongshan, and Zhaoqing. It has established an overseas manufacturing base in Vietnam to support international market expansion. Sales are concentrated in South China, East China, and direct exports account for a significant portion of revenue, reflecting a growing global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Silver Age operates primarily in the midstream segment of the polymer materials supply chain, focusing on the modification and enhancement of base polymer resins into high-performance materials. It also extends downstream into smart lighting product manufacturing and 3D printing material development, integrating material innovation with end-product solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-performance, environmentally friendly, and functional modified plastics, including halogen-free flame retardants and bio-based materials. It invests in smart lighting innovations integrating IoT and AI technologies, and advances 3D printing materials for industrial applications. Key projects include PCR material development, durable PA66, low linear expansion PC/ABS, and high-flow PPO alloys, aiming to enhance product differentiation and meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of modified polymer materials and smart lighting products. The company adopts a make-to-order production model based on customer orders, emphasizing direct sales to reduce intermediaries and provide technical services. It also earns income from overseas exports and occasional investment returns, with a focus on product sales rather than licensing or subscription models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Silver Age is positioned as a leading and competitive player in China's modified plastics industry, with strong technological innovation and a comprehensive product portfolio. It faces competition from domestic small-scale producers in low-end markets and international petrochemical giants in high-end segments. The company leverages its R&D capabilities, customer relationships, and cost advantages to maintain and enhance its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.02 billion, representing a 21.38% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising 90.33% to about RMB 51.45 million. The company has steadily expanded production capacity and invested in new facilities domestically and overseas. Despite some cash flow fluctuations, the overall financial scale and growth trajectory demonstrate solid performance and ongoing expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Silver Age emphasizes high-performance, environmentally friendly, and customized polymer materials that meet stringent industry standards and regulatory requirements. Its integrated smart lighting solutions combine advanced materials with IoT and AI technologies, offering differentiated products with superior quality, technical support, and rapid development cycles. The company’s scale, strategic supplier partnerships, and comprehensive service system provide customers with reliable, cost-effective, and innovative material solutions.
